title: Hearty German Cassoulet
description: A twist on the classic French dish, this German-inspired cassoulet is filled with comforting white beans, savory sausage, and a hint of quick pickled onions.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, cook the sliced sausage over medium-high heat until browned.
Remove the cooked sausage from the pot and set it aside.
Add the savory sausage broth to the pot and bring it to a simmer.
Stir in the cooked white beans and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the torn french bread to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the cooked sausage to the pot and stir to combine.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Serve the cassoulet hot, garnished with quick pickled onions.
